game: CLE@TEN Week 7 2026, morning-of-kickoff pack only, TEN +2, total 37, implied CLE 19.5 / TEN 17.5, kickoff time and venue surface not in pack

script.base: A 2-point spread and a 37 total (CLE 19.5, TEN 17.5) point to a tight, low-event game, not a shootout and not a blowout, so starter snaps should hold. Deshaun Watson (Dillon Gabriel out) and Quinshon Judkins try to nick a late lead; Tony Pollard (49 carries, 176 yards in weeks 4-6) keeps Tennessee on the field. Both passing games have been flat (CLE EPA/dropback -0.03 vs blitz and +0.03 vs none; TEN +0.05 vs blitz and -0.25 vs none), so the lean is run-and-checkdown more than explosives.
script.flip1: Cleveland scores early, Watson hands off, and the clock-kill stalls Jeudy and Boston the way a lead stalled Dak's yards in the skill example; Pollard's carries also die if Tennessee abandons the run while trailing.
script.flip2: Pollard grinds against a CLE run defense allowing 4.56 YPC with Mike Hall Jr. and Kalia Davis out, Tennessee controls clock, Cleveland chases, Watson scrambles, and intermediate targets (Jeudy) rise while deep Boston shots stay inefficient.

injury_fallout: Official pre-game nflverse report, known before kickoff; inactives not saved. CLE: Dillon Gabriel OUT (Back) locks Deshaun Watson in (already 19 carries / 93 rush yards in weeks 4-6). Teven Jenkins OUT (Back) is the offensive-line hit: pressure up, Judkins rushing efficiency down (already 31/97, 3.1 YPC), more quick throws so RB/TE catches and intermediate WRs gain relative to deep Denzel Boston (19 targets, 339 air yards, only 150 receiving yards). DT Mike Hall Jr. OUT (Ankle) and DT Kalia Davis OUT (Quad) thin a run defense already at 4.56 YPC and 24 runs of 10+, which is the Pollard fallout. CB Denzel Ward QUESTIONABLE (Hand) and LB Quincy Williams QUESTIONABLE (Neck) are not OUT; if Ward sits, Carnell Tate/Wandale Robinson face a backup, and if Williams sits, Tyjae Spears and Gunnar Helm get a lighter LB. TEN: Calvin Ridley QUESTIONABLE (Hip) already only 7 targets / 46 yards in weeks 4-6, so a sit would push targets to Tate (24/221/360) and Robinson (19/94/126), not a new role. Tyjae Spears QUESTIONABLE (resting, not injury) is not OUT/Doubtful; if he sits, Pollard absorbs a small share (Spears 5 carries / 8 yards in three games). S Tony Adams QUESTIONABLE (Ankle) and S Kevin Winston Jr. QUESTIONABLE (Quad) would help Boston deep shots if both sit. LB Dorian Mausi QUESTIONABLE (Foot) is a mild Harold Fannin / Judkins receiving boost only if inactive. No final inactives, so questionable tags stay unresolved.

CLE defense: rush YPC 4.56 and 24 runs of 10+ (the bleed), pass YPA left 6.62 (74), middle 7.95 (41), right 6.09 (90), 19 passes of 20+ for 224 yards. Perimeter is not a giveaway; the middle is.
matchup.overlap: CLE's air-yards king is Denzel Boston (339 air, 150 yards), which overlaps TEN's leaky secondary, but the yards are not converting and Jenkins out points away from deep shots. The cleaner overlap is Jerry Jeudy (14 targets, 124 yards, 139 air, about 9.9 air yards/target) into a defense allowing 7-plus YPA in every zone, in a quick-game script. TEN's overlap is Pollard into CLE's 4.56 YPC and two missing DTs, and Tate (360 air on 24 targets) into a perimeter that is not the CLE bleed unless Ward sits.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and the slip lost. Jeudy went 19 or 0 again because the unidentified Titans corner took the intermediate away, Boston's one explosive (he already has an 89 in the recent three) and Concepcion's 64-yard spike ate the limited CLE pass yards in a 19.5 team total, and an early lead let Judkins (last-4 rush games of 70, 53, 44) kill the clock. Watson finished at 24 or under because TEN blitzed only 23% and the 4.06 YPC front funneled carries to Judkins and McLaughlin instead of keepers, so the 40-yard game was the outlier the 28.5 line was waiting on. The missing sim never vetoed a fair -114.5 price, and a late Ward or Spears inactive would have changed the other side of the ball without saving these two.
slip_story: One story only: missing-guard, Gabriel-out Cleveland pressure script in a 37-point game. Watson rush over 28.5 and Jeudy rec over 21.5 win together if Cleveland is competitive or trailing and the quick game plus keepers show up. Do not add Boston deep overs, a game-total over, Tate 52.5 (needs a pass-volume script the +2/17.5 number does not promise), or Pollard over (needs Tennessee to own the run, the other flip). Fannin under would be the same quiet-pass story but fights the TE-checkdown rule, so it stays off the slip. Two legs, no TDs, one market per player.
